title: chore(harness): remove Maestro so plain prompts stop triggering its recon gate
body:
Maestro fired "MAESTRO ACTIVATED" on ordinary prompts (for example "orchestrate this") and then blocked direct kraken spawns, though Dave never asked for it. The Workflow tool replaces Maestro, so this removes it.

Removed: the three maestro hooks (enforcer, state manager, cleanup), their dist files, the maestro agent and skill, the stress and e2e tests that only tested Maestro, `shared/state-schema.ts`, and `session-start-recovery` (its only feed was `maestro-cleanup`; nothing handled its reply). Cleaned: `skill-router` (TS and Python), both `claude_spawn.py` copies (the orchestrate route now goes to `architect`), two rules, `skill-rules.json`, project registry, docs, and the audit-skills baseline (G04 maestro entry, 2 in each scope).

## Merge order (live settings.json)

`~/.claude/settings.json` is NEVER_SYNC and still registers the four removed hooks. After the merge, before the sync, run `node scripts/settings/remove-maestro-registrations.mjs --apply` (it backs up to `settings.json.bak-maestro`). Do not run `capture-active-registrations.mjs` first: it copies active registrations back into the repo.

## Scope not included

- `registration-reconcile` floors (MIN_LIVE_ENTRIES 75, MIN_LIVE_NAMES 68) go below the floor after this (73 entries, 64 names). Dave decides whether to lower them.
- `audit-skills --include-active --update-baseline` after the sync.
- Dashboard `AgentsDetail` colour map and its fixtures still name `maestro` as a historical agent type.
- `sync-architecture-stats.mjs` (history-class generated docs).
